claim: NSCORE = 8 is the number of high-score entries, so the ladder is eight rungs deep (not the shared ten). RADIX 16, so the bare 8 is hex eight (claim RX-1).
HSCORE reserves 3*NSCORE bytes for the high-score table: three BCD score bytes per entry, stored LSB,MIDDLE,MSB (little-endian).
INITL reserves 3*NSCORE bytes: three initials per entry, paired positionally with HSCORE.
GETINT is the routine that gets the player's initials for the high score — three initials, driving the initials buffer.

source.verbatim: .SBTTL	GETINT-GET PLAYERS INITIALS FOR HIGH CORE
